installer_checks: Status and dry-run: original file untouched, no backup/stage created; spaces and Unicode in paths
Running-game guard rejects writes (simulated process query, fixture only)
Install confirmation: No, empty and invalid answers cancel without creating or changing files
Yes confirmation installs the exact tested DLL and stores an exact original backup
Full -> Compatibility -> Full switching uses the original backup and produces verified hashes
Uninstall cancellation leaves the installed mod and original backup intact
Uninstall restores the original byte-for-byte, preserves its backup and is idempotent
Unknown DLL / Steam-update / other-mod hashes cannot be overwritten by install or uninstall
Corrupted or unrelated backup is preserved and blocks installation
Missing-original-backup guard protects already modified installations
An existing staging file is never overwritten or deleted
Corrupt payload/hash/range fails before creating a backup or replacing the game DLL
All public files ASCII/English; checksums valid; no full game binary, original game art, save or personal paths
Easy package exposes only Install/Uninstall and a short README; all launchers resolve the bundled script and use English prompts
note: Public sources reproduce the released DLL byte-for-byte. Eight isolated x64 test groups run at two ASLR bases; installer tests use disposable fixtures. These checks do not validate GPU rendering or whole-game stability.
